judgment.notes: M011 at S002 is instantiated with X=ℝ, Q=Measure ℝ on its Borel structure, ν=λ, T=ℕ and B_i=J_i. D010 types λ as such a measure; the native evaluation/OuterMeasureClass bridge is positively checked in BG005, and ℕ is countable. M011 requires no measurability of J or W. N005 applies separately to each nonempty W_i: its diameter ρ_i is finite, 0≤ρ_i≤δ, and η=ε2^{-i-1}>0. Empty members use λ(∅)=0 instead. N001's power limits are used only with a-1>0 and s-1<0; its dimension implications are used with positive exponents and the same Euclidean set I. Routine power applications and all their signs are checked in BG002–BG004 and BG006–BG009. There are no E applications.
